title: Vampire Vape Charger Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Charger by Vampire Vape offers a delightful mix of succulent berries, exotic fruits, and an intoxicating medley of luscious red fruits. This parade of irresistible ripe fruit flavours is accentuated by a cool menthol touch and a subtle, spicy notes of aniseed for a truly unique flavour experience. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production, and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. These Vampire Vape Nic Salt e-liquids are perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts along with a super-smooth throat hit. Unlike regular freebase e-liquids, nicotine salts’ alkaline formulation allows for a higher concentration of nicotine while delivering a smoother throat hit than high-strength freebase liquids are capable of. With nicotine salt e-liquids, the nicotine is absorbed into the bloodstream faster, providing near-instant relief from nicotine cravings.
